note: Kernel micro-fixtures for web/lib/resample.js (spec/web-tests.md level 1d). Conventions: PIL resize = separable convolution, center-aligned samples, kernel widened by max(1, scale) on downsampling, PIL F mode accumulates in float64, 8-bit images use int32-quantized weights (22 precision bits) per pass with an 8-bit intermediate; transform/rotate = point-sampled inverse map (0.5-center convention, no antialiasing, out-of-source centers filled with 0); devpairs.radial/shrink are numpy ports (radial runs in float64 with the pipeline's float64 s,k).
